argv:
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
from reprollm.schemas.run_record import RunRecord
from reprollm.schemas.state import State
from reprollm.core.yaml_io import load_manifest
p=Path(sys.argv[2]);r=RunRecord.model_validate_json(p.read_text())
s=State.from_run(r,run_dir=p.parent)
m=load_manifest(p.parent/'manifest.yaml')
t=State.merge(m,run=s);u=State.merge(m,run=t)
v=State.merge(run=State.model_validate_json(u.model_dump_json()))
def leaves(x):
 q=x.flatten()['generation.temperature']
 def count(z):return 1+sum(count(a) for a in z.alternatives)
 return {'value':q.value,'source':q.source,'detail':q.detail,'evidence_count':count(q),'leaf':q.model_dump(mode='json')}
from reprollm.export.exporter import build_input
from reprollm.diff.state import _snapshots,observed_state
manifest,lock=_snapshots(r,p.parent)
export=build_input(manifest,lock,r,State.merge(manifest,lock,observed_state(r)),reprollm_version=r.reprollm_version)
print(json.dumps({'selected':[leaves(z) for z in [s,t,u,v]],'export_generation':export.generation},sort_keys=True))

argv:
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
from reprollm.schemas.run_record import RunRecord
from reprollm.schemas.state import State
from reprollm.core.yaml_io import load_manifest
p=Path(sys.argv[2]);r=RunRecord.model_validate_json(p.read_text())
s=State.from_run(r,run_dir=p.parent)
m=load_manifest(p.parent/'manifest.yaml')
t=State.merge(m,run=s);u=State.merge(m,run=t)
v=State.merge(run=State.model_validate_json(u.model_dump_json()))
def leaves(x):
 q=x.flatten()['generation.temperature']
 def count(z):return 1+sum(count(a) for a in z.alternatives)
 return {'value':q.value,'source':q.source,'detail':q.detail,'evidence_count':count(q),'leaf':q.model_dump(mode='json')}
from reprollm.export.exporter import build_input
from reprollm.diff.state import _snapshots,observed_state
manifest,lock=_snapshots(r,p.parent)
export=build_input(manifest,lock,r,State.merge(manifest,lock,observed_state(r)),reprollm_version=r.reprollm_version)
print(json.dumps({'selected':[leaves(z) for z in [s,t,u,v]],'export_generation':export.generation},sort_keys=True))

argv:
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
from reprollm.schemas.run_record import RunRecord
from reprollm.schemas.state import State
from reprollm.core.yaml_io import load_manifest
p=Path(sys.argv[2]);r=RunRecord.model_validate_json(p.read_text())
s=State.from_run(r,run_dir=p.parent)
m=load_manifest(p.parent/'manifest.yaml')
t=State.merge(m,run=s);u=State.merge(m,run=t)
v=State.merge(run=State.model_validate_json(u.model_dump_json()))
def leaves(x):
 q=x.flatten()['generation.temperature']
 def count(z):return 1+sum(count(a) for a in z.alternatives)
 return {'value':q.value,'source':q.source,'detail':q.detail,'evidence_count':count(q),'leaf':q.model_dump(mode='json')}
from reprollm.export.exporter import build_input
from reprollm.diff.state import _snapshots,observed_state
manifest,lock=_snapshots(r,p.parent)
export=build_input(manifest,lock,r,State.merge(manifest,lock,observed_state(r)),reprollm_version=r.reprollm_version)
print(json.dumps({'selected':[leaves(z) for z in [s,t,u,v]],'export_generation':export.generation},sort_keys=True))

import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
from reprollm.schemas.run_record import RunRecord
from reprollm.schemas.state import State
from reprollm.core.yaml_io import load_manifest
p=Path(sys.argv[2]);r=RunRecord.model_validate_json(p.read_text())
s=State.from_run(r,run_dir=p.parent)
m=load_manifest(p.parent/'manifest.yaml')
t=State.merge(m,run=s);u=State.merge(m,run=t)
v=State.merge(run=State.model_validate_json(u.model_dump_json()))
def leaves(x):
 q=x.flatten()['generation.temperature']
 def count(z):return 1+sum(count(a) for a in z.alternatives)
 return {'value':q.value,'source':q.source,'detail':q.detail,'evidence_count':count(q),'leaf':q.model_dump(mode='json')}
from reprollm.export.exporter import build_input
from reprollm.diff.state import _snapshots,observed_state
manifest,lock=_snapshots(r,p.parent)
export=build_input(manifest,lock,r,State.merge(manifest,lock,observed_state(r)),reprollm_version=r.reprollm_version)
print(json.dumps({'selected':[leaves(z) for z in [s,t,u,v]],'export_generation':export.generation},sort_keys=True))

from reprollm.core.yaml_io import load_manifest
p=Path(sys.argv[2]);r=RunRecord.model_validate_json(p.read_text())
s=State.from_run(r,run_dir=p.parent)
m=load_manifest(p.parent/'manifest.yaml')
t=State.merge(m,run=s);u=State.merge(m,run=t)
v=State.merge(run=State.model_validate_json(u.model_dump_json()))
def leaves(x):
 q=x.flatten()['generation.temperature']
 def count(z):return 1+sum(count(a) for a in z.alternatives)
 return {'value':q.value,'source':q.source,'detail':q.detail,'evidence_count':count(q),'leaf':q.model_dump(mode='json')}
from reprollm.export.exporter import build_input
from reprollm.diff.state import _snapshots,observed_state
manifest,lock=_snapshots(r,p.parent)
export=build_input(manifest,lock,r,State.merge(manifest,lock,observed_state(r)),reprollm_version=r.reprollm_version)
print(json.dumps({'selected':[leaves(z) for z in [s,t,u,v]],'export_generation':export.generation},sort_keys=True))
